lines.en: I'm gonna be moving out, man.
Hey, Joey, Joey, are you okay?
Yeah, I've got to go. I've got an acting job.
Look, I'm just gonna be right across the hall,
and I promise you, the minute Monica and I break up,
I'm moving right back in with you.
If you're gonna be moving in with him,
I feel that it is my responsibility
to tell you the truth about him.
Okay? He's a terrible roommate. Terrible.
Oh, my kidding. He's the best roommate ever.
